MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing feels like a useful next purchase because it would insulate and protect connections made with my earlier crimp connector kit.",
    "The locking nut assortment fits my interest in practical repair supplies, although I would need to confirm the sizes before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Traction tape and super glue accelerator serve different purposes from my repair tape and vinyl cement; those purchases do not establish a need for either product.",
    "The stropping wheel and printer filament require equipment I have not shown that I own, while the sound meter addresses a measurement task I have not needed.",
    "Owning a handtruck does not mean I am packing for a move, and buying portion cups does not mean I need liquid droppers or a large prep table."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop tool or supply.",
    "Similar words or materials, such as tape and adhesives, seem to matter more than whether the products solve the same problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A clear connection to a task I have already bought supplies for matters more to me than a broad resemblance to something I used before.",
    "Dimensions and compatibility matter: even useful repair hardware is only worth choosing when it fits the job.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so an older purchase alone does not establish an ongoing project or a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my practical repair interests, but too often assume unrelated projects or equipment instead of following a specific demonstrated need."
}
